_note: Bandwidths are theoretical peaks from spec sheets (GB/s, 1e9 bytes/s) unless 'basis' says measured. Calibration: see 'calibration_source'.

calibration.calibration_source: RTX 3060 12 GB + Ryzen 5 5600X (DDR4-3200 dual channel), 2026-11-09: GEMV ~300 GB/s of 360 (e_gpu), CPU K-quant GEMV ~34 GB/s of 51.2 (e_cpu). usable_vram_fraction reproduces the 57/7 split of Qwen2.5-32B on a desktop whose display uses ~1.2 GB; t_fixed_gpu_ms fitted to Llama 3.1 8B (59.6 tok/s, all GPU); t_cpu_layer_ms to Llama 3.1 8B fully on the CPU (6.9 tok/s); t_handoff_ms (GPU+CPU split only) to Qwen2.5-32B 57/7 (12.25 tok/s).
